title: finance-dashboard
text:
Committed and opened: Atemndobs/financial-dashboard#27

Branch feature/tax-prep-checklist, one commit d4d37eb, 11 files, +791/-18. Working tree is now clean.

What I committed: the checklist feature (page, client component, prep-checklist.ts), the reworked tax dashboard client, the eight dining merchants in rules.ts, and the previously untracked agent config and docs.

What I deliberately did not commit: .env.production.pull. It holds a production CLERKSECRETKEY, and committing it to a public repo would be a real leak, so I added .env*.pull to .gitignore instead. I also ignored graphify-out/ rather than committing 2.2 MB of artifacts the hook regenerates on every branch switch. If you actually wanted either of those tracked, say so and I'll change it, but I won't commit the secret.

Verified: tsc --noEmit clean outside the pre-existing chart.tsx errors, and I confirmed no env file was staged before committing. I did not run the app, so the feature itself is unverified beyond types.

One thing I flagged in the PR body rather than fixing: convex/lib/rules.ts and the Python app/categorize/rules.yaml are still drifting. This PR advances the TS side; the YAML side has that separate 89-line rewrite staged over in the parent repo. Your CLAUDE.md asks for those two to stay in sync.

Want me to reconcile them next, or deal with the outer repo's git hygiene?
